name: Oberon Chat
author: oberonie

sections.description:
Oberon Chat delivers a polished, privacy-aware GPT experience to your WordPress site. Configure prompts, tone, rate controls, and interface styling directly from wp-admin, while every conversation is captured for review or compliance.

Highlights

  • Chat Experience – AI responses backed by your choice of OpenAI (ChatGPT), Google Gemini, or Anthropic Claude with system prompts, context window control, and an optional natural delay.
  • Brand-Ready UI – Customize the chat badge, colours, text treatments, agent name, greeting, and reach visitors with both trigger styles out of the box (advanced bubble background/text colours require Pro).
  • Prompt Presets – Pick from goal-based system prompts (lead generation, support, product discovery) and insert them with one click.
  • Transcript Vault – Store complete conversation logs, email stale sessions automatically, and review, export, or delete transcripts within WordPress.
  • Admin Friendly – WordPress Settings API integration, color pickers, nonce-protected AJAX, and cron cleanup ensure the plugin plays nicely in production.
  • Performance & Safety – Inline history trimming on both client and server protects API usage, Pro-only settings revert to safe defaults if the licence lapses, and no UI assets load in admin or on pages without the shortcode.
  • Backend LLM Hub – Configure your provider, API key, and preferred model from a dedicated tab.

External Services

Oberon Chat connects to third-party large language model APIs when you supply your own credentials:

  • OpenAI (https://api.openai.com/v1/chat/completions, https://api.openai.com/v1/models) – Sends system prompt, trimmed message history, and optional function definitions; receives the generated reply. Subject to OpenAI Terms and Privacy Policy.
  • OpenRouter (https://openrouter.ai/api/v1/models) – Optional model discovery endpoint for OpenRouter-compatible keys. See OpenRouter Terms and Privacy Policy.
  • Google Gemini (https://generativelanguage.googleapis.com/v1beta/models) – Used to fetch available Gemini models and send chat completions. Governed by the Generative Language API Terms and Google Privacy Policy.
  • Anthropic Claude (https://api.anthropic.com/v1/models) – Accessed for model discovery and chat completions with supplied keys. Covered by the Anthropic Terms of Service and Privacy Policy.

Only the data required to fulfil each request is transmitted directly from your server to the selected provider; the plugin does not proxy or log API payloads beyond the optional transcript storage you control.

Accessibility & Localization

Frontend markup includes ARIA attributes, focus states, and keyboard-friendly controls. Text strings are translation-ready via the oberon-chat text domain.
sections.installation:
1. Upload the oberon-chat folder to the /wp-content/plugins/ directory or install through the WordPress plugins screen.
  2. Activate the plugin via Plugins → Installed Plugins.
  3. Visit Oberon Chat → Settings to add your Backend LLM connection(s), then tailor prompts, activation rules, and the chat interface.
  4. Embed the assistant anywhere with the [oberon_chat] shortcode or the provided menu toggle.
sections.faq:
Do I need an AI provider account?

Yes. Bring your own API key(s) for OpenAI, Google Gemini, or Anthropic Claude and add them on the Backend LLM tab—the plugin never exposes them publicly.

How do I limit token usage?

Set the “Chat History Length” option to control how many prior exchanges are sent with each request. Older history is trimmed before the API call.

Can I export transcripts?

Every transcript can be viewed, emailed, or deleted from Oberon Chat → Transcripts. Export from there or copy the log into your CRM.

Is the widget translation-ready?

All strings use esc_html__() / esc_attr__(); load your translations via the standard WordPress mechanism.
